content: {"tax_bps":150,"endowment_share":60,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Volume is healthy (24.66 NEAR buys vs 9.64 sells) and the curve price is holding, so a modest tax cut to 150 bps should support growth without starving the funds. Buyback fund holds 0.1766 NEAR; at ~0.108 NEAR per basis point of supply, I can afford a 1 bp burn this meeting — small, but it compounds the floor daily as petitioners asked.
